description: Todos, Capture, and Honeycrisp, which Epicenter bundles (`bundled_apps.rs`), each run in one window per folder, labelled <page>:<digest of the folder's directory>. The shell binds each window's one folder to it before the window exists, and the page opens it with the folder plugin and refreshes visible queries in TypeScript. Each page holds its window's close until what is typed saved, brings unfinished input forward (core:window:allow-set-focus), and destroys its own window only after saving (core:window:allow-destroy). These pages call no account, AI, history, or app command. Whispering's windows have their own file, whispering.json. Its pages are served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
